rows.title: opportunity stage gates handling procedure
rows.body: [SUPERSEDED 2025] opportunity stage gates records verified in status "inactive" must be moved to status "active". This document may be outdated.

rows.title: opportunity stage gates handling procedure (rev. 2)
rows.body: [CURRENT — effective 2026-06-01, supersedes all prior versions] For opportunity stage gates records verified in status "inactive": if the record's created_at is "2025-06-12", move it to status "pending"; otherwise move it to status "active". Apply exactly one transition.
